[FACT] User is a member of a family of five.  
[EVENT] User is planning a trip to Yellowstone National Park.  
[EVENT] User just got back from a 10-day road trip to Yellowstone with their family last month.  
[FACT] User rented an RV for their last trip to Yellowstone and drove from California.  
[ASSISTANT] Recommended accommodations:  
[ASSISTANT] Canyon Lodge & Cabins: Located in the heart of Yellowstone, offers comfortable rooms and cabins for families of five.  
[ASSISTANT] Grant Village: Situated on the shores of Yellowstone Lake, offers lakeside rooms and cabins for families of five.  
[ASSISTANT] Yellowstone Gateway Inn: Located in West Yellowstone, Montana, offers spacious rooms and suites for families of five.  
[ASSISTANT] Recommended activities:  
[ASSISTANT] Guided Tours: Kid-friendly tours focusing on wildlife viewing, geysers, and park history.  
[ASSISTANT] Upper and Lower Yellowstone Falls: Short hikes to the brink of the Upper Falls and scenic trails around the Lower Falls.  
[ASSISTANT] Yellowstone Lake: Rent a boat or take a guided tour to spot wildlife.  
[ASSISTANT] Mammoth Hot Springs: Explore travertine formations, stroller-friendly.  
[ASSISTANT] Ranger Programs: Various ranger-led programs including nature walks and Junior Ranger activities.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided tips for planning:  
[ASSISTANT] Book early for accommodations and guided tours.  
[ASSISTANT] Check the park's website for updates on trail closures and wildlife sightings.  
[ASSISTANT] Pack layers, sunscreen, and comfortable hiking shoes.  
[ASSISTANT] Schedule downtime and breaks throughout the day.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in family-friendly accommodations and activities.  
[PREFERENCE] User expressed interest in keeping kids occupied during long drives.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided tips for keeping kids occupied during long drives:  
[ASSISTANT] Audiobooks and podcasts for engagement.  
[ASSISTANT] Road trip bingo with common road items.  
[ASSISTANT] Classic car games like "I Spy" and "20 Questions."  
[ASSISTANT] Tablets and handheld games with educational apps.  
[ASSISTANT] Snack and drink stations for kids.  
[ASSISTANT] Regular pit stops for breaks.  
[ASSISTANT] Scavenger hunts for items to find on the road.  
[ASSISTANT] Car karaoke for singing along to favorite songs.  
[ASSISTANT] Travel journals for documenting the trip.  
[ASSISTANT] Taking turns for music and games to reduce squabbles.
